name: Dexterous hands
description: A compact mechanical foundation for grasping, articulation and embodied-AI research. Built around our micro-drive architecture.
detail: Discuss hand configuration, drive integration, sensing interfaces and the acceptance tests for your application.

name: Quadruped platform
line:
A different way
to move forward.
description: A wheeled quadruped architecture that brings actuation, structure and embedded control into one development platform.
detail: Define terrain, payload, compute, power and control requirements with the engineering team before selecting a configuration.

name: Spherical robot
description: An enclosed spherical architecture for exploring a different relationship between mechanics, stabilization and movement.
detail: Explore shell design, stabilization, power and AGX-class compute integration as a scoped development program.

name: Dual-arm platform
description: An integration platform for coordinated arm motion and end-effector development, using the same modular actuation foundation.
detail: Work with the team on reach, joint configuration, end effectors, controls and application-specific verification.
